name: NICW Wrestlefest — RSP-WF Edition

date.source: The post's own dateline and its 'RSP-WF Edition' framing, a special single-match cut of the fed's own Wrestlefest supercard for the newsgroup.

matches.title: nicw-1996-world-heavyweight
matches.finish: Mike D'Angelo took the third and deciding fall with a Claw Hold submission after Falcon had won the first fall and D'Angelo the second.
matches.stipulation: NICW World Heavyweight Championship — 30-minute Ironman match, best two-of-three falls

notes: A newsgroup-only cut of NICW's own 'Wrestlefest' supercard carrying just its main event; the full fourteen-match card (announced 13 May 1996) is not otherwise recovered in the held record.
